children: Petronas Chemicals' earnings may face pressure from weakness in key petrochemical product prices alongside softer crude oil prices, says Hong Leong IB analyst Thye May Ting in a note. She expects prices and profitability are likely to face challenges in in 2027-2028 as global supply recovers and downstream demand is subdued. Fertilizer and methanol prices are expected to grapple with Chinese urea exports rising and Middle Eastern methanol supply recovering. Hong Leong cuts the company's 2026-2027 earnings estimates by 30% and 22%, respectively, downgrades its rating to hold from buy and cuts its target price to 3.73 ringgit from 5.49 ringgit. Shares are 3.9% lower at 3.65 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
